trust_decision.summary: Which exporter configuration (endpoint, URL with userinfo/query token, Insecure flag) may appear in internal logs; decided in each component's MarshalLog, which feeds the V(4) 'TracerProvider created' info log in sdk/trace/provider.go.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'exporter config logging may leak endpoint URLs'; the OTLP HTTP trace client's MarshalLog returns Endpoint and Insecure directly. It is the most-used exporter and the obvious first grep hit for MarshalLog plus Endpoint.

fix_sites.entry_point: otlptrace.New / otlptrace.NewUnstarted(client), a public wrapper around any Client
sdktrace.NewTracerProvider(WithBatcher(e)) / NewBatchSpanProcessor, which logs any SpanExporter's MarshalLog

fix_sites.module_kind: SDK composition (processor embeds exporter; fix also copies the exporter under exporterMu)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: sdk/trace/batch_span_processor.go:435-444 and sdk/trace/simple_span_processor.go:142-150 (processors put the whole exporter object into the logged struct); also exporters/otlp/otlptrace/exporter.go:97 (wrapper puts the Client into the logged struct)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Once the built-in exporters' MarshalLog stop returning the endpoint, the SDK processors and the otlptrace wrapper look safe. Changing them to %T only matters for third-party exporters/clients, which a solver can call the exporter author's responsibility.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The 'TracerProvider created' info log must still be emitted and must keep each component's Type ('otlptracehttp', 'otlptracegrpc', 'otlptrace', 'zipkin', 'BatchSpanProcessor') and the BatchSpanProcessorOptions Config. The zipkin exporter must still POST to the full URL, keep its WithLogger flow logs, and keep the invalid-URL error text that a test asserts. Deleting the log line or MarshalLog, or redacting e.url itself, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: host:port endpoint with userinfo via WithEndpoint (fix.diff:159-161, fix.diff:246)
full collector URL with userinfo and query token for zipkin (fix.diff:281)
Insecure flag as a config field next to the endpoint (fix.diff:252)
arbitrary third-party SpanExporter/Client whose own MarshalLog returns an endpoint, through batch and simple processors and the otlptrace wrapper (fix.diff:64-66, fix.diff:369-371, fix.diff:378-385)

O7_producer.where: MarshalLog methods (logr.Marshaler) at exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp/client.go:337 and sdk/trace/batch_span_processor.go:435; the logger walks them recursively from sdk/trace/provider.go:48-62

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Zipkin export logs the full collector URL (userinfo and query token) at Info on every export, and in the error paths, through the WithLogger/WithLogr logger.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It is an opt-in, per-exporter debug logger rather than 'exporter config logging', and the advisory and changelog talk about the MarshalLog/'TracerProvider created' path.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file as the zipkin fix site, different function (ExportSpans/logf at exporters/zipkin/zipkin.go:192-201)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Zipkin errf returns errors containing the full URL; the SDK error handler then logs them (request create / request failed).
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Error values are not logs, and the URL in an error is useful for diagnosis.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The metric PeriodicReader embeds the whole Exporter object in its MarshalLog, and the 'MeterProvider created' info log logs it. This is the same pattern the fix changed to %T in the trace processors.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Metric signal, while the changelog names only trace packages. The built-in OTLP metric exporters already return only a Type (exporters/otlp/otlpmetric/otlpmetrichttp/exporter.go:139-141), so only third-party exporters leak.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: WithEndpointURL logs the raw endpoint URL at Error level (always enabled) when url.Parse fails.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Only happens for malformed input, and it is a parse-error diagnostic rather than config logging. It is also generated from internal/shared/otlp/otlptrace/otlpconfig/options.go.tmpl:283, with a copy in exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracegrpc/internal/otlpconfig/options.go:283.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: internal config package two levels below the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The env-var reader logs the raw OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*ENDPOINT value at Error level when url.Parse fails.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Legacy/env config loader, only on malformed values, and generated from a shared template (internal/shared/otlp/envconfig/envconfig.go.tmpl:98).
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: internal envconfig package; copies in otlptracegrpc and otlpmetric* internal/envconfig

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Self-observability BaseAttrs logs the endpoint at Debug on parse failure; a realistic sibling would log it at Info on success when building component attributes.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The observ package already handles the endpoint string and logs it, so a maintainer adding a 'exporter instrumentation configured' log is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: PeriodicReader already embeds the exporter; a planted otlpmetrichttp MarshalLog returning Endpoint would make this route leak with built-in exporters.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It matches the pre-fix otlptracehttp MarshalLog shape exactly (exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp/client.go:337-347).

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A log exporter MarshalLog or 'LoggerProvider created' info log carrying the endpoint.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The log SDK has no MarshalLog yet; adding one in the trace style is a natural maintainer change.

O9_family: CWE-532 sensitive information (endpoint URL with credentials/token) in log output

O10_build.project_tests: go test in sdk/trace (provider_test.go), exporters/otlp/otlptrace, otlptracegrpc (client_test.go), otlptracehttp (client_internal_test.go), exporters/zipkin (zipkin_test.go); tests capture logs with go-logr funcr, no network needed (zipkin uses a local httptest collector)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Drop Endpoint from the otlptracehttp (and maybe otlptracegrpc) MarshalLog and stop, leaving zipkin, the otlptrace wrapper and the SDK processors embedding arbitrary exporters unchanged.

out_of_scope_notes: The envconfig 'escape header value' error log can print an OTLP header value, which may be an auth token (exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp/internal/envconfig/envconfig.go:181). This is a header, not the endpoint.
